chunks: You can only warn him who listens to the warning and fears Ar-Rahman secretly. So give him good news of forgiveness and a generous reward.

key_terms.الذِّكْرَ: The remembrance, specifically referring to the Quran
key_terms.الرَّحْمٰنَ: The Merciful, a key divine attribute
key_terms.بِالْغَيْبِ: In secret or unseen, indicating private devotion

ai.seo_question: Who is the specific audience for divine warning according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ideal state of the believer who internalizes the Quran, combining outward adherence with inward reverence (khushu') for Allah even when unseen. It serves as a comforting assurance that true piety, characterized by quiet devotion rather than mere public display, is the gateway to divine forgiveness and a generous reward.
